svg.aria-label: RPO and RTO on a timeline. The last good backup or replicated point is taken, then disaster strikes. The recovery point objective, RPO, is how much data you can afford to lose: the gap between the last recoverable point and the disaster. The recovery time objective, RTO, is how long you can afford to be down: from the disaster until service is restored.
